note: A foreground bash abort retries until Rust has registered the task, so an early interruption is no longer lost, and the OpenCode 2 abort scenario waits on an observed running task row instead of a fixed delay. Also captures the Windows libtest output as an artifact, because GitHub has twice failed to serve that job's log. Plugin bash tool, OpenCode 2 harness and CI only; no file under the ranking fence is touched, and no engine, corpus or indexed-content change.
